description: S11's entire job is production disk I/O (read SUPABASE_URL+service-role rows, write the live-served apps/landing/public/dashboard.json), but 1b only proves the PURE `renderDashboard({rows, reader, existing})` core (render-dashboard.test.js) — zero requirement or test covers the effectful CLI wrapper. Two concrete failure modes are unaddressed: (a) if SUPABASE_URL/SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY are unset or the fetch fails in production, does the script still run with rows=[] and silently OVERWRITE the existing good `leaderboard` with an empty array, wiping real agents off the live site? (b) app/dashboard/page.tsx:29-31 does a synchronous `fs.readFile` + `JSON.parse` per request (revalidate=60); a non-atomic partial write to dashboard.json by render-dashboard.mjs while a request is in flight would make JSON.parse throw, and page.tsx:31 catches ALL parse errors and returns null, so page.tsx:36 renders 'data unavailable' for the ENTIRE /dashboard page (not just the leaderboard section). Neither failure mode is named in S11.1-S11.3 nor proven in 1b.
